_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Instructional Media Requirements Document
summary: Specifies the media selection model, primary and alternate media requirements, and functional requirements for the instructional delivery system, serving as the baseline for instructional media performance specifications.
use_relationship:
The Instructional Media Requirements Document provides specifications for the media selection model used, a description of primary and alternate media requirements, and functional requirements for the instructional delivery system. Its purpose is to serve as the baseline for instructional media performance specifications.

a.  This Data Item Description (DID) contains the preparation instructions for the content and format of the Instructional Media Requirements Document.

b.  This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the performance requirements described by 3.2.3 of MIL-PRF-29612B, and is applicable to the acquisition of training data products. Data product performance evaluation criteria are specified in 4.3.3 of MIL-PRF-29612B.

c.  It is not intended that all the requirements contained herein be applied to every program or program phase. Portions of this DID are subject to deletion tailoring depending upon the program phase in which it is applied in the contract. Any individual data requirement contained in this DID is subject to deletion tailoring.

d.  This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81519B.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The contractor format is acceptable.  Standard digital data, when specified, must be in compliance with the content and format requirements specified in the DoD Data Architecture (DDA) and the Defense Data Dictionary System (DDDS).

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Instructional Media Requirements Document shall contain the following:

children.title: Front matter
children.content: The content of front matter shall be in accordance with Appendix A of MIL-PRF-29612B.

children.title: Part 1: Media selection model specifications data
children.content: The model data shall describe the procedures to be used to identify primary and alternate media for each Learning Objective (LO) and shall include:

children.title: Methodology for identifying the sensory stimulus requirements of the LOs
Method for identifying the sensory stimulus of the media
Procedure for consideration of LOs presentation sequence in the selection of media
The hardware and software specifications if the model is automated
Special proprietary license requirements, if any
The relationship between media selection and course outline development
children.content: (i.e., does media selection follow course outline development; or does course outline development follow media selection).

children.title: A flow chart which shows the questions asked, the decision points, and the sequence of events for media selection
Part 2: Media selection analysis data
children.content: The media selection analysis data shall provide descriptions of the source of the instructional media requirements, the results of the media selection and allocation process, and descriptions of primary and alternate media and methods to satisfy each LO.

children.title: Instructional media requirements source data
children.content: The data shall include a summary of the historical background of the training requirements analysis, a description of the operational system, and a discussion of the scope, magnitude, and constraints of the analysis. The data shall also include a summary description with a justification for the proposed media as follows:

children.title: A description of the purpose and function of the operational system
A description of unique knowledge, skills, and attitudes required for the operational system
children.content: Identify existing applicable training systems and their shortfalls. Provide rationale (e.g., safety, non-availability, cost) for use or non-use of operational equipment for training.

children.title: A description of significant events and source documents
children.content: (e.g., training concept document, training plan) that detail the training requirement and training deficiency, and the resulting evolution of the training requirement.

children.title: Instructional delivery system selection
children.content: This data shall include the following:

children.title: A description of resources and constraints impacting media selection
A list of sensory stimulus requirements
children.content: (e.g., sound, visual, motion, color) required for each training task, LO, or learning event, and degree of realism required.

children.title: Primary and alternate instructional delivery systems
children.content: (e.g., paper-based materials, films, IMI, simulator, Internet, intranet) capable of providing sensory stimulus for each training task, LO, and learning event.

children.title: A summary of the media features analysis
children.content: including man-machine interface devices, visual output features, audio output, and motion features shall be provided in matrix or narrative format with the following content:

children.title: Identification of critical features and their relationship to LOs
Identification of applicability of features to LOs
Identification of the frequency of application to LOs
A chart showing the daily schedule of learning events and activities
children.content: in relation to the primary and alternate instructional delivery systems.

children.title: A chart showing the time sequence of learning events and the recommended media mix
children.content: The chart shall be organized using unit and lesson numbers, lesson titles and learning objective relationships.

children.title: A chart of the total media resources required
A description of the life cycle cost analysis
children.content: (i.e., procurement, development, and implementation as appropriate) and evaluation of the advantages and disadvantages training effectiveness) of the alternatives.

children.title: A description of the results of trade studies made on vendor equipment
children.content: for the purpose of selecting preferred media, training equipment, and courseware production tools. It shall include rationale to justify selection of new versus existing media and methods.

children.title: Recommendations
children.content: The recommendations data shall contain:

children.title: A recommendation for the media features
children.content: (hardware and software) which includes the rationale for each feature based on LOs.

children.title: A recommendation identifying the best suited instructional delivery system
Purpose of the instructional delivery system
Adverse impact if instructional delivery system is not provided
For distributed learning, a description of requirements
children.content: for Course Management System (CMS), Learning Management System (LMS), communication tools, reference resources, and student station hardware and software requirements.

children.title: Part 3: Instructional delivery system functional characteristics data
children.content: The data shall describe the instructional delivery system functional characteristics as follows:

children.title: Training considerations
children.content: The training considerations data shall summarize the training analysis which forms the basis for development of the instructional delivery system. It shall include the following:

children.title: A description of any assumptions which affected the instructional delivery system requirements
A summary of requirements from source documents
children.content: (e.g., training concept document, training plan).

children.title: A summary of the process used to conduct the instructional delivery system requirements analysis
A description of performance goals
children.content: (expected achievement levels).

children.title: A list of knowledge, skills, and attitudes to be trained
A description of training strategies, methods, and techniques
A description of the trainee population as follows
Initial, peak, and steady state quantity of trainees per session
Initial, peak, and steady state quantity of sessions per year
Qualifications
children.content: (i.e., entry level knowledge and skills).

children.title: A description of instructor requirements as follows
Prerequisites and qualifications
children.content: (e.g., education, military grade and occupation, civilian grade or occupational series, experience).

children.title: Anticipated instructor to student ratios
children.content: (e.g., classroom, laboratory).

children.title: A description of utilization as follows
Relationship of instructional delivery system to existing training program
Type of instruction
children.content: (e.g., individualized, team, subteam).

children.title: Percent of training time using the instructional delivery system
Description of exercise(s) to be conducted using the instructional delivery system
Anticipated usage to include hours of operation per day and week
Functional characteristics
children.content: The functional characteristics data shall describe the instructional delivery system in terms of performance capabilities. The description shall include the following:

children.title: A description of the constraints to include
Operational baseline constraints imposed by the configuration of the operational equipment
Physical constraints to include
children.content: technological, fiscal, personnel, hazards, environmental, and security.

children.title: Assumptions to include
children.content: platform or equipment characteristics, targets, physical environment, and exercise scenarios.

children.title: A description of the functional characteristics to be modeled to include
A general description to include the
Role of operational equipment to be modeled
System or equipment performance and capabilities to include
Sensor systems
children.content: (e.g., sonar, radar, periscope).

children.title: Dynamic performance characteristics
children.content: (e.g., speed, depth, altitude).

children.title: Training modes of operation to include
Basic modes
children.content: (e.g., individual).

children.title: Joint modes
children.content: (e.g., team, subteam).

children.title: Alternate or degraded modes of operation
Acceptable tolerances of degradation in training equipment
children.content: before training is aborted.

children.title: Specific behavioral objectives to be trained with the equipment
Functional performance characteristics of the instructor operator station
Trainer facility configuration including interfaces between trainer subsystems
Manning
children.content: (i.e., qualitative and quantitative characteristics of instructors and operators).

children.title: Test and evaluation of the instructor operator station
Control of training problems
children.content: (i.e., manual or automated).

children.title: Instructor flags
children.content: (e.g., identification of events in program).

children.title: Controller models
children.content: (i.e., simulated conditions).

children.title: Performance measurement diagnosis and recording capability
Reinitialization and restart of frozen simulation program
Communications
children.content: (i.e., cued, recorded, or selective).

children.title: Instructor aids
children.content: (e.g., assistance, tutorials).

children.title: Management reports and findings for student evaluation
Areas of fidelity critical to training
A description of the interfaces with other stations, training devices, or systems
children.content: including communication networks.

children.title: A list of faults to be modeled
Types and number of student stations
Unique types of information to be presented
Cues which can be modified, slowed, accelerated, enhanced, or reduced
Other information pertinent to the training characteristics
A description of the availability and use to include
Design goals for steady state availability
children.content: such as hours per day and days per week.

children.title: Design goal for the operating life
Probability of lesson completion without failure
Reliability goal in terms of mean time between failures
Maintainability goals in terms of system mean time to repair and maximum corrective maintenance time
A description of the installation site requirements to include
Existing training system or complex into which the new instructional delivery system is to be integrated
Mockup or equipment layout
children.content: inclusive of Government Furnished Equipment (GFE).

children.title: Facilities required
children.content: (e.g., new building construction, building modifications, power, air conditioning, reinforced flooring).

children.title: Unusual requirements for electromagnetic environmental effects
Security requirements
children.content: (e.g., physical, automatic data processing, electromagnetic).

children.title: Other unusual environmental conditions
children.content: (e.g., temperature variations, water, vibration, dust).

children.title: PrePlanned Product Improvement (P3I)
children.content: (The P3I data should be included only when a difference exists between the functional performance baseline required in the trainer to meet the training need as defined in 2.4.2 above, and that capability which is technically achievable through standard commercial practices within known limitations of funding availability, producibility, or supportability. This information is of use to: (1) influence training device design, (2) identify the resource base needed to implement the required performance enhancements subsequent to training equipment delivery, or (3) to provide the basis for a research initiative to achieve full performance.) The P3I plan shall identify required capabilities which will not be delivered with the first article development and shall describe the plan of action to correct the shortfall. This subsection shall provide a summary of P3I data to include:

children.title: Training capabilities not provided and rationale
Plan for training system upgrade to full capability
Training system support considerations
children.content: The support considerations data shall provide a description of the concepts, goals, and constraints which will control design of media, to include:

children.title: A description of the support program as follows
Level and type of support analysis anticipated
Description of any differences in strategy or support considerations between the prototype and production units
Anticipated operational test and evaluation parameters
A description of the maintenance planning as follows
Anticipated differences in maintenance concept between the prototype and production units
A description of the technical data support package as follows
Qualification documents for instructors, operators, and maintainers
Support and technical documentation for instructors, operators, and maintainers
A description of the personnel staffing to include identifying the sources of support personnel
children.content: (e.g., contractor operation and maintenance, Government civilian, military).

children.title: A description of the contractor engineering and technical services as follows
Anticipated contractor engineering, technical, and maintenance services required for both prototype development and test and evaluation
Contractor engineering and technical services needed for production units following the ready-for-training date
A description of the life cycle support as follows
Planned hardware and software support approaches
children.content: (i.e., Government, contractor, or Government and contractor).

children.title: Requirements to establish, operate, and maintain training system support capability
Length of anticipated initial support period
Type and level of supply support
Unusual parameters in provisioning or technical documentation
Part 4: Training system modification data
children.content: This data shall describe the modification required to an existing training system. The data shall include:

children.title: A description of the training deficiency causing the requirement for the training system modifications
A comparative analysis of modification life cycle costs, training gains, and equipment system life expectancy
Estimates of training resource savings or other gains to include
Appendices
children.content: The appendices shall include the following:

children.title: Appendix A
children.content: A list of references.

children.title: Appendix B
children.content: A bibliography.

children.title: Appendix C
children.content: Key milestone dates, key decision points, and points of contact.

children.title: Appendix D
children.content: A distribution list.

children.title: Appendix E
children.content: A list of definitions, acronyms, and specialized terms.

preparation_instructions.title: Standard digital data
preparation_instructions.content: Standard digital data shall be delivered for the Standard Data Elements (SDEs).
